integrity: The even-characteristic direction is proved by an explicit local subring of the full matrix algebra whose nonunits are exactly its nilpotent radical. The odd-characteristic direction reduces to the published classification of realizable odd-primary p-groups. A standalone checker exhaustively verifies the explicit ring construction in representative prime and nonprime fields.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for unitriangular groups over finite fields, not arbitrary finite coefficient rings.
The odd-characteristic obstruction invokes the established Ditor classification of realizable finite groups of odd order.
The theorem concerns ordinary realizability as a finite ring unit group, not full endomorphism-lifting realizability.
title: Finite unitriangular groups have an exact realizability dichotomy
